items.originalTitle: Alpine drivers penalised post-race, Ryo Hirakawa scores on F1 debut at Mexico GP
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly and Franco Colapinto were given post-race penalties for failing to slow under yellow flags at the Mexico Grand Prix, dropping both Alpine drivers out of the points and allowing Haas debutant Ryo Hirakawa to score on his Formula 1 debut.
detailZh: 阿尔派车手赛后受罚，平川亮在墨西哥大奖赛F1首秀中得分
阿尔派车手加斯利和科拉平托双双在赛后受到处罚并跌出积分区，哈斯车手平川亮因此在墨西哥大奖赛的F1首秀中收获积分
皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派车队；弗兰科·科拉平托，阿尔派车队
皮埃尔·加斯利和弗兰科·科拉平托均被处以赛后处罚，跌出积分区，哈斯新秀平川亮因此在墨西哥大奖赛的F1首秀中收获积分。
两位阿尔派车手在墨西哥城正赛后都因在黄旗状态下未减速而面临国际汽联干事的调查。在临时成绩中，科拉平托以第八名完赛，而他的队友加斯利获得第十名。
加斯利因在双黄旗挥动下未充分减速而被处以停站再出发处罚——该处罚在赛后转换为30秒罚时——而科拉平托则在赛后因在单黄旗挥动下未充分减速而被处以10秒罚时。
这位阿根廷车手曾面临与加斯利相同的处罚风险，但根据国际汽联干事报告，他在双黄旗路段被认定无违规，因为“有充分理由怀疑该车手是否获得了足够的警告以遵守要求，因此未认定该路段存在任何违规行为”。
在墨西哥大奖赛最终成绩中，加斯利被降至第17位，科拉平托被降至第15位。
再加上迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里因与阿尔维德·林德布拉德发生碰撞而在赛后受到10秒罚时，这三位车手因此跌出了积分区。
利亚姆·劳森升至第七位，这一位置原本属于皮亚斯特里；而奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托则从积分区外直接跃升至第八位。
红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔也出现同样情况，从第12位升至第九位；而F1新秀平川亮则为哈斯车队拿下第十名，完成积分区的收尾。
这位日本车手是在周五晚间美国车队因未说明的原因决定让埃斯特班·奥康坐冷板凳后临时被征召的，这给了平川亮完成F1正赛首秀的机会。
detailEn: Alpine drivers penalised post-race, Ryo Hirakawa scores on F1 debut at Mexico GP
Alpine pair Pierre Gasly and Franco Colapinto have picked up post-race penalties and drop out of the points, resulting in Ryo Hirakawa scoring on his F1 debut at the Mexico GP
Pierre Gasly, Alpine, Franco Colapinto, Alpine

Pierre Gasly and Franco Colapinto have both been given post-race penalties which have dropped them out of the points and resulted in Haas debutant Ryo Hirakawa scoring on his Formula 1 debut at the Mexico Grand Prix.

Both Alpine drivers faced post-race investigations with the FIA stewards for failing to slow under yellow flags during the Mexico City race. In the provisional results Colapinto finished in eighth place while his team-mate Gasly took 10th.

Gasly was given a stop-and-go penalty for failing to slow sufficiently under double waved yellows – which was converted into a 30-second penalty post-race – while Colapinto was given a 10s penalty after the race, having failed to slow sufficiently under single waved yellows.

The Argentinean driver was at risk of the same punishment as Gasly, but was cleared of wrongdoing in a double yellow sector because “there was sufficient doubt that the driver had sufficient warning in order to comply with the requirements, so did not determine that there was any breach in relation to that sector,” according to the FIA stewards report.
In the final Mexico GP classification it dropped Gasly down to 17th place with Colapinto demoted to 15th place.
Coupled with a post-race 10s penalty for McLaren’s Oscar Piastri for clashing with Arvid Lindblad, it sees the trio of drivers drop out of the points-paying positions.
Liam Lawson has moved up to seventh place, originally taken by Piastri, while Audi’s Gabriel Bortoleto has jumped from outside of the points entirely into eighth place.
The same situation occurs for Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar who moves from 12th to ninth, while F1 debutant Hirakawa completes the points in 10th place for Haas.
The Japanese driver was a late call-up for the US team after it opted to bench Esteban Ocon for unspecified reasons on Friday night, giving the opportunity to Hirakawa to make his F1 race bow.
keyPointsZh: 两位阿尔派车手在墨西哥城比赛中的黄旗时段未减速，赛后接受国际汽联干事调查
处罚结果使加斯利和科拉平托跌出积分区
keyPointsEn: Both Alpine drivers were investigated by the FIA stewards after the Mexico City race for failing to slow under yellow flags
The penalties dropped Gasly and Colapinto out of the points

items.titleZh: 双倍处罚让阿尔法罗密欧墨西哥站全部积分付诸东流
items.summaryZh: 阿尔法罗密欧车手弗朗科·科拉平托和皮埃尔·加斯利因违反黄旗规则而受到处罚，导致车队在墨西哥大奖赛上失去双倍积分。
items.originalTitle: Double penalty costs Alpine all its Mexican GP points
detailZh: 阿尔卑斯车队的车手弗朗科·科拉平托和皮埃尔·加斯利因在墨西哥大奖赛中导致车队失去双倍积分而向车队道歉，因为他们都因违反黄旗规则而受到处罚。
科拉平托和加斯利原本分别排在第八和第十位，但在奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂里因在第一弯与阿维德·林德布拉德发生碰撞而被处以10秒赛后时间处罚后，他们的排名分别提升至第七和第九位。
但由于皮亚斯蒂里与林德布拉德发生事故后，两位车手都被认为没有遵守黄旗规则，这八分积分最终丢失。
科拉平托因在通过单个挥动的黄旗时没有减速足够，被处以10秒时间处罚。
科拉平托和阿尔卑斯车队“展示了遥测和摄影证据，声称这证明了[科拉平托]已经遵守了规定，规定驾驶员必须减速并准备好改变方向。”
然而，这“未能令裁判满意”科拉平托在通过单波次黄旗时已经足够减速。
由于“对驾驶员是否得到了足够的警告以便遵守要求存在足够的怀疑”，他在前一个赛段的两次波次黄旗违规中被判无罪。
但对他单次波次黄旗违规的10秒罚时使他降至第15位。
队友加斯利受到了更严厉的处罚，他被判停赛并行驶，这被转换成了30秒的时间扣除，使他排名17，成为最后一位有资格的赛车手。
阿尔派和加斯利声称，该车手在双黄旗区域显著降低了速度；然而，对遥测数据和通过该区域的其他车辆的详细检查导致裁判员得出结论，所记录的小幅降低不足以满足规则的要求。
加斯利的处罚更重，因为这是在双挥动黄旗下的违规行为，因此他还得到了两个罚分。
尽管阿尔派在裁判员听证会上为其车手辩护，但在车队赛后新闻发布会上，两人都表示了道歉。
“我为黄旗违规向车队道歉，这是我的错误，显然阻止了我们得分，”加斯利说。“在我们这边，有一些事情需要我们反思，因为我感觉如果我们没有遇到一些问题，我们可以排在更高的位置。对我来说，这不是一个好的一天，有很多东西需要反思。”
“我为黄旗下发生的事情向车队中的每一个人道歉，”科拉平托说。“虽然很难真正理解，但这是我在车上的错误。”
他们的处罚使得从维修区起步的利亚姆·劳森升到了第七位，这意味着小红牛车队在 车队的第五名争夺战中获得了六分，领先阿尔卑斯车队35分。
这一裁决也将加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托和伊萨克·哈达尔提升到第八和第九名，进入了积分榜。
这意味着Ryo Hirakawa在哈斯车队令人意外的首秀中，以第10名的成绩获得积分。
detailEn: Alpine drivers Franco Colapinto and Pierre Gasly have apologised for losing the team a double points finish at Formula 1's Mexican Grand Prix as both picked up penalties for yellow flag infringements.

Colapinto and Gasly were eighth and 10th over the line and then promoted to seventh and ninth when Oscar Piastri was hit with a 10-second post-race time penalty for clashing with Arvid Lindblad at Turn 1.
But that haul of eight points has been lost because both drivers were deemed to have not followed yellow flag rules after Piastri's incident with Lindblad.
Colapinto picked up a 10-second time penalty for passing a single waved yellow flag and not slowing down enough.

Colapinto and Alpine "presented telemetry and photographic evidence claiming it demonstrated that [Colapinto] had complied with the regulations which state that the driver must reduce speed and be prepared to change direction".
However, this "failed to satisfy" the stewards that Colapinto had sufficiently reduced his speed when passing the single waved yellow flag.
He was cleared of speeding through the double waved yellow flag in the previous sector because of "sufficient doubt that the driver had sufficient warning in order to comply with the requirements".
But the 10s penalty for his single waved yellow flag infringement dropped him to 15th.
Team-mate Gasly got an even harsher penalty as he was given a stop-and-go penalty that was converted into a 30s time drop, leaving him 17th as the last classified driver.

Alpine and Gasly "claimed that the driver had made a significant reduction in speed in the double yellow flag sector; however, a detailed examination of the telemetry and that of other cars passing through that sector led the stewards to conclude that the small reduction noted was not sufficient to satisfy the requirements of the regulations".
Gasly's penalty is bigger because it's an infringement under double waved yellow flags, so he also gets two penalty points.
Though Alpine had argued its drivers' case in the stewards' hearings, both apologised in the team's post-race press release.

"I am sorry to the team for the yellow flag infringement, it is my error which has obviously stopped us from scoring points," said Gasly. "There are a few things for us to look at on our side as I felt we could have been much higher up had we not had some of the issues. It's not been a great day for me, a lot to reflect on."
"I am sorry to everyone at the team for what happened under the yellow flag," said Colapinto. "While it is difficult to really understand, it is my mistake in the car."

Their penalties move Liam Lawson, who started from the pitlane, into seventh place, meaning six more points for Racing Bulls that move it to 35 clear of Alpine in their battle for fifth in the constructors' championship.
The ruling also promotes Gabriel Bortoleto and Isack Hadjar into the points in eighth and ninth.
And it means Ryo Hirakawa scores a point on his surprise debut for Haas in 10th place.
keyPointsZh: 科拉平托和加斯利因违反黄旗规则被处以时间处罚。
科拉平托因未在单黄旗区域减速足够而被罚10秒。
加斯利因更严重的违规行为被罚30秒，最终排名第17。
keyPointsEn: Both drivers were penalized for yellow flag infractions.
Colapinto received a 10-second penalty for not slowing down enough during a single waved yellow flag.
Gasly was given a 30-second penalty, dropping him to 17th place.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔赛后缺席媒体采访，梅赛德斯被罚5000欧元
items.summaryZh: 墨西哥大奖赛赛后，拉塞尔未按规定前往媒体区接受采访，梅赛德斯因此被赛会罚款5000欧元。梅赛德斯解释称，拉塞尔因比赛中的能量部署问题和10秒罚时情绪低落，故未出席。
items.originalTitle: Mercedes explains 'distraught' Russell's post-race absence after fine
items.summaryEn: Mercedes has been fined €5,000 by the Mexican Grand Prix stewards after George Russell failed to attend his post-race media duties. Mercedes explained that Russell was distraught following an energy deployment problem and a 10-second penalty in a race where his team-mate Kimi Antonelli won the title.
detailZh: 墨西哥大奖赛赛会干事对梅赛德斯车队处以罚款，原因是乔治·拉塞尔在队友基米·安东内利夺得总冠军的那场比赛后未履行媒体义务。
拉塞尔未前往媒体区接受转播商和文字媒体采访。
根据国际汽联F1运动规则第B10.1.4e条，每位车手无正当理由都必须出席，因此他在周日晚被传唤至赛会干事处，梅赛德斯随后被罚款5000欧元。
梅赛德斯解释称，他们为拉塞尔免除了这一义务，因为他在赛后“情绪极度低落”。拉塞尔在比赛起步阶段遭遇能量部署问题，从第一排位置向后掉队。他与红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔发生碰撞，因此被罚10秒，最终以第六名完赛，而安东内利则登上领奖台并夺得拉塞尔曾希望属于自己的总冠军。
尽管拉塞尔没有参加梅赛德斯的庆祝活动，但他在赛后确实向安东内利及其家人（见上图）表示了祝贺。
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫解释道：“赛后我在国际汽联称重区看到了乔治，显然他对当时的情况感到非常沮丧。”
“他主动去看望基米，展现了极佳的体育精神。我认识乔治已经很久了。他正经历一段艰难时期，但当初也是他出力把这名年轻人带进了这支车队。”
“对一名赛车手来说，这是灾难性的一刻，也许今天的比赛多少就是他这个赛季的缩影。”
“这本来是一场他该赢的比赛。我们的赛车有速度。可我们在第一段直道上让他失望了。能量输出没有达到我们预期的水平。”
“此刻我非常理解他。我也经历过那种极其、极其难以应对的局面。”
“所以他不做媒体工作、离开赛道，完全可以理解。他要是留下来，反倒会让我意外。”
detailEn: Mercedes has been fined by Formula 1’s Mexican Grand Prix stewards for George Russell not attending his media duties after the race in which team-mate Kimi Antonelli won the title.
Russell failed to attend the media pen to speak to broadcasters and the written media.

This is required of every driver without a valid reason not to attend, as per Article B10.1.4e of the FIA’s F1 sporting regulations, so he was summoned to the stewards on Sunday evening, with Mercedes then given a €5000 fine.

Mercedes explained it excused Russell because he was "distraught" after the race. Russell had an energy deployment problem at the start of the race that sent him backwards from the front row. He collided with Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar, picked up a 10-second time penalty for that and ended the race sixth, while Antonelli claimed a podium and the title Russell once hoped would be his.
Although Russell did not attend Mercedes’ celebrations, he did congratulate Antonelli and his family (pictured above) after the race.
"I saw George after the race on the FIA scales and obviously he's distraught about the situation," Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff explained.

"It was a great show of sportsmanship to go and see Kimi. I have known George for such a long time. He is going through a hard time, but he was also responsible in getting the young man into this team.
"For a racing driver, this is a catastrophic moment and maybe today the race was a little bit a picture of his season.
"This was a race for him to win. We had the pace in the car. And we let him down on the first straight. The energy delivery was not what we thought it should be.
"I'm very much with him at the moment. I've been in situations where it’s very, very difficult to cope.
"So him not doing the media work or leaving the track is absolutely understandable. Him staying would have actually surprised me."
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔在比赛起步阶段遭遇能量部署问题，从第一排位置向后掉队。
拉塞尔与红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔发生碰撞，被罚10秒，最终以第六名完赛。
安东内利登上领奖台并夺得车手总冠军，这正是拉塞尔曾希望获得的头衔。
keyPointsEn: Russell had an energy deployment problem at the start of the race that sent him backwards from the front row.
Russell collided with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar, received a 10-second time penalty and finished sixth.
Antonelli claimed a podium and the title that Russell had once hoped would be his.

Gasly gets a stop and go penalty and Colapinto a 10-second time penalty imposed after the race, both for failing to slow for yellow flags. Both drop out of points
Promotes Lawson to P7, Bortoleto to P8, Hadjar to P9, and Ryo Hirakawa gets a point on debut in P10! #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
加斯利因未能为黄旗减速而获得一次停赛和10秒的罚时，科拉平托也因同样原因在赛后被处以10秒的罚时。两人均未能获得积分
提升劳森至第7位，博托莱托至第8位，哈吉尔至第9位，而里奥·伊拉卡瓦在首秀中获得了第10位并得到一分！#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
